1946-4590-7070.notablePrerequisites: You have attacked 2 or more opponents this turn.
1946-4590-7070.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Nomads en-Kor.
The Nomads en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Nomads en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
Repeat.

2829-4131-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2829-4131-5660-6769.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Basalt Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

317-728-1475.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-728-1475.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

3532-5078-5957-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6604-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1339-5070-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-5070-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-3259-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1895-2781-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-7373-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Tellah
1618-2440-7373-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Tellah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-7373-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Tellah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost 2 or more life this turn.
5686-6972-7230.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

628-2193-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Repeat.

1409-4772-5419.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve the Kalain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

141-1269-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1269-5256.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-997-1115.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3372-5466-6472.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Deceptive Frostkite
3372-5466-6472.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Deceptive Frostkite by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Deceptive Frostkite into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Deceptive Frostkite's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Deceptive Frostkite's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Deceptive Frostkite's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1350-4872-6333-6678.manaNeeded: {5}{W} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1350-4872-6333-6678.description:
Cast Time Warp from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1251-1563-2457-3129.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

457-5078-5390-6289.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

2557-4508-4875-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

372-3563-4125.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Shipwreck Dowser exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
372-3563-4125.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

803-2569-3957-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
"Merfolk" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2569-3957-4289.description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1692-2743-2751-3094.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Biovisionary.
1692-2743-2751-3094.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Resolve all Helm of the Host triggers, creating three token copies of Biovisionary with haste.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1723-2512-4046.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Starlit Sanctum's second ability by paying {W}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

770-4191.description:
Cast Man-o'-War without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Man-o'-War enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1261-2271.notablePrerequisites: Tickster Mage does not have summoning sickness.
1261-2271.description:
Activate Trickster Mage by paying {U}, tapping it, and discard a card, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
